name: Four Seasons Hotel Amman
positioning: Four Seasons hotel on Jabal Amman, set upon the highest of Amman's seven hills
best_for: Travelers who want a central home base to discover Jordan
Guests who want both an indoor pool and a rooftop outdoor pool
Guests who like a French brasserie and a Japanese Nikkei lounge on site

facts.text: The hotel has 192 rooms in total.
Four Seasons Hotel Amman is the first Four Seasons hotel built in the Middle East.
The hotel is set upon the highest of Amman's seven hills.
The hotel's address is 5th Circle, Al-Kindi Street, Jabal Amman.
The hotel is a 30-minute drive from Queen Alia International Airport.
La Capitale is a French brasserie.
SIRR Japanese Lounge serves Japanese Nikkei cuisine.
The hotel has a rooftop outdoor pool.
The hotel has an indoor pool that is open all year round.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: La Capitale includes Jordan's first farm-to-glass, seasonal bar menu.
The Nabatean Treatment uses olive seeds, Oud oil and Argan oil for a full-body experience.
Complimentary parking is offered for all guests.
Condé Nast Traveler says breakfast at Olea is a window into Jordanian and Levantine cuisine.
Condé Nast Traveler says the Nikkei menu serves up some of the best-quality sushi in town.
Condé Nast Traveler reports that recent renovations have been completed in all the rooms.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is open from May 1 through mid-October.
Condé Nast Traveler says getting around on foot is not easy because it involves crossing many busy streets.
Condé Nast Traveler says security is tight, with multiple checks of entering vehicles and personal belongings.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, full breakfast for two is included daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
